result.title: How to compress text to 1 bit per character | Compression is Intelligence Part 3
result.description:
Arithmetic codes and how they elucidate this trilogy's title
Channel career fair: https://3b1b.com/talent
New store items! https://3b1b.com/store
Early views for supporters: https://3b1b.com/support

Other resources you may enjoy.

On Asymmetric numeral systems:
https://arxiv.org/abs/0902.0271
https://demonstrations.wolfram.com/DataCompressionUsingAsymmetricNumeralSystems/
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2201.01741v2
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.13867

On Arithmetic Codes:
https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/214762.214771

Ilya Sutskever, An Observation on Generalization
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AKMuA_TVz3A&t=24s

A bit on prequential coding:
https://yidingjiang.github.io/blog/post/curriculum/

A few other good papers/posts on the relationship between compression, prediction, and ML:
https://deepmind.google/research/publications/39768/
https://www.hutter1.net/ai/uaibook.htm
https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/3-540-62858-4_69
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0005109878900055

Timestamps:
0:00 - The absurdity of Shannon’s estimate
6:27 - From text to real numbers
16:57 - Is this Shannon’s limit?
20:26 - Reframing pretraining
22:41 - Arithmetic codes in action
27:29 - Reflections on “Compression is Intelligence”
36:30 - Three ways to support

Secret Enscreen Vlog: https://youtu.be/hoX3IiKXT-M
